title: Routing policy schema validator and safe rollback playbook
creator: Priya Nair
summary: After a capacity event we had a routing-policy format change rolled without validation which caused mismatched variant routing and cross-region reroute oscillation. This ticket covers building a schema validator, automating a safe rollback path, improving telemetry to detect policy/variant mismatches, and executing the follow-up action items from the postmortem.
postmortem_findings: A staged policy change introduced an optional field 'variant_constraints' with different expected types between control-plane and edge shard leading to silent parsing failures
When parsing failed a default empty constraint was used which caused some regions to select incompatible model variants and trigger repeated fallback retries
KV cache mismatch between routing decision shard and execution shard amplified reassignments causing cross-region fanout and increased latency
No canary detector was in place for policy schema drift; automated preflight validation did not run for this deploy path
Runbook rollback required manual steps and took 27 minutes; lack of an automated safe-rollback API prolonged impact
root_cause: Control-plane policy codec change was deployed without a schema validator and without binding tests to ensure compatibility across edge routing shards; fallback heuristics treated parse failures as permissive defaults which enabled incompatible variant selections.
repro_steps: Deploy policy JSON with variant_constraints as string instead of object to staging routing control-plane
Trigger policy propagation to edge shards via normal rollout (simulated capacity spike to force fallback)
Observe edge shard parse path returning default empty constraint and selecting variant based on precedence rules
Simulate KV cache staleness on one regional shard to see repeated reroutes and fanout behavior
impact: Increased latency for ~12% of traffic for 27 minutes; 3 enterprise customers observed elevated tail latency and one customer reported a time-limited error spike (approx 0.9% above normal error rate).
action_items: Implement a strict routing policy JSON schema validator in the control-plane that rejects incompatible policy shapes and blocks rollout (owner: Diego Morales, due: 2026-03-18)
Add schema versioning header to policies and perform compatibility checks during propagation (owner: Priya Nair, due: 2026-03-21)
Create an automated safe-rollback API that can revert policy snapshots across the fleet atomically with a canary step (owner: Liam O'Connor, due: 2026-03-25)
Hard-fail parsing on shards when encountering unknown types and emit clear diagnostic telemetry instead of falling back to permissive defaults (owner: Maya Alvarez, due: 2026-03-18)
Reconcile KV cache reconciliation interval and add a reconciliation job that validates policy/kv consistency every 5 minutes (owner: Diego Morales, due: 2026-03-26)

Ship a canary gate in the deployment pipeline that validates policy application on a sampling of shards and runs a synthetic workload verifying variant compatibility (owner: SRE Team, due: 2026-03-22)
Update runbook with step-by-step rollback playbook and tabletop run schedule (owner: Oncall Rotation Lead, due: 2026-03-15)
Add alerting rule for 'policy-parse-error-rate' and 'variant-selection-entropy-delta' with runbook links (owner: Observability, due: 2026-03-14)
Conduct postmortem tabletop with product, design, and SRE to validate customer communication and SLA impact modeling (owner: Priya Nair, due: 2026-03-19)
Add integration test in CI that serializes and deserializes the policy object across control-plane and edge clients (owner: DevEx Team, due: 2026-03-20)
Run a backward-compatibility sweep against known policy variants stored in policy-snapshots bucket (owner: Diego Morales, due: 2026-03-23)
rollback_playbook: Step 1: Identify impacted policy snapshot ID from propagation logs (search 'policy-propagation' dashboard) (operator)
Step 2: Use safe-rollback API to pin fleet to last-known-good snapshot and mark rollout as 'rollback-in-progress' (SRE)
Step 3: Run quick validation: sample 0.5% of requests routed through canary shard and validate variant tag vs expected table (SRE + DevEx)
Step 4: If canary passes, expand rollback to 25% then 100% (automated, with helm-style progressive expansion)
Step 5: After rollback complete, trigger KV cache reconciliation job and monitor 'variant-selection-entropy-delta' for 30 minutes (operator)
Step 6: If rollback fails, execute 'circuit-breaker' isolation to limit cross-region fanout and divert to safe default model variant until manual remediation (engineering oncall)
Step 7: Post-rollback, create incident timeline and notify customers via template (PM)
observability_changes: Add policy-schema-validation metric and dashboard tile showing validation fail counts per region
Instrument shard-level parse error logs with policy snapshot id and shard id for root-cause correlation
Create a composite alert for simultaneous increase in parse errors + cross-region reroutes
Expose variant-selection heatmap to Console and add token-cost impact per variant for customer-facing transparency
